hero.title: Clarity for every market day.
hero.body: Suq Insights is being built to turn the records merchants already keep into a clear daily view of sales, stock, and returning customers.
hero.status: Development environments are ready. Product implementation is underway.

questions.label: The three questions Suq Insights will answer

selling.title: What is selling?
selling.body: See revenue, transactions, units, patterns, and the items driving change.

stock.title: What will run out next?
stock.body: Understand stock status, days remaining, and what may need attention today.

customers.title: Which customers come back?
customers.body: See repeat business clearly when confirmed customer information supports it.
